scope: GEAS3.5 cucumber Profile-A-specific offline simulator policy; not universal/optimal/live policy
training_unit: one valid finalized admitted simulator decision transition, counted once when committed to this on-policy update; PPO epochs do not multiply training_steps

sampling.unit: uniform by natural Train run, not parent episode or transition
sampling.rule: sorted run_id schedule, PCG64 default_rng(seed) shuffle without replacement each full pass; same RNG persists; no reward-conditioned replacement
sampling.short_runs: all included, natural length, no padding/filter
sampling.reset: run first legal row with frozen history/carry; explicit run_id and policy seed; no random interior reset
sampling.train_rng: dedicated np.random.Generator(PCG64(seed)); torch CPU policy RNG seeded seed; Python/NumPy global seeded seed separately
sampling.development_rng: deterministic complete sorted schedule; separate env; save and restore Python/NumPy/torch plus sampler RNG states; verify exact equality before/after

batching.collect: freeze policy parameters while gathering batch; finish each natural run before checking >= target; consume entire finalized batch exactly once
batching.gae: compute identity/fragment-aware dual-mask GAE with old-policy final values; concatenate then batch-normalize advantages
batching.nominal_boundary: do not truncate a simulator run at nominal target, continue to terminal; no fragment optimization
batching.administrative_truncation: only explicit interruption; b=1,c=0 genuine final obs; keep all fragments provisional, complete same in-memory episode before update; invalid rollback/failure mask correction preserved
batching.resume: only post-update clean episode boundary, empty provisional and ready buffers; interrupted unfinished batch must restart from last approved checkpoint, no partial resume
batching.zero_length_failure: log failure attempt, no row; advance predetermined schedule
batching.system_invalid_unscorable: quarantine entire episode then technical stop seed; never repeatedly omit invalid runs to fill a batch
batching.attempt_limit: do not reset a new run if remaining attempted allowance < that run length; stop technical if no full-run allowance; no mid-run budget fabrication

development.schedule: all fixed development natural runs, sorted run_id; 11 parent episodes; no skip
development.selection_denominator: all scheduled natural runs, including zero-step and quarantined
development.no_complete_mean: null, ranking key +infinity for negative-return term; not zero reward
development.baseline: evaluate fresh seed-specific update0 before learning; include update0 in ranking
development.selected_per_seed: one per seed from development only; no winning seed discard
development.quality_improvement_claim: compare to same-seed update0 using full lexicographic outcomes; conditional COMPLETE reward alone insufficient

contents: Profile A and target binding identity/registry hash
dedicated sampler RNG + current permutation + position/pass
checkpoint.retention: retain every scheduled checkpoint within fixed cap; update0 included, selected references existing file; reload creates no extra checkpoint
checkpoint.resume_mismatch: reject, never update pinned original metadata
checkpoint.budget_placeholder: future authorized training driver binds this experiment payload hash; original minimal adapter artifact remains unchanged
checkpoint.clean_boundary: post-update only; update0 before any batch; no pending fragments/rows
checkpoint.stop_during_batch: preserve diagnostics; last scheduled checkpoint remains authoritative; unfinished data cannot silently become admitted

final_test: sealed candidate only; no read/hash/evaluation now or in smoke/main
